name: bash-permissions
description: Asks before dangerous Bash commands (git push, gt submit, pscale deploy, mysql, …) with a one-sentence explanation and a danger score. /bash-permissions shows the rules.

alwaysAllow.title: Always allowed rules
alwaysAllow.description: Rule IDs that never ask, comma separated (e.g. git-commit, gt-modify). "Always allow" in the prompt adds to this list. /bash-permissions rules lists every ID.

alwaysAsk.title: Extra rules that ask
alwaysAsk.description: Rule IDs that are off by default but should ask, comma separated (e.g. rm-rf, sudo, git-reset-hard).

explain.title: Explain commands
explain.description: Ask a model for a one-sentence explanation and a 1–100 danger score before prompting. Off: a built-in sentence and the rule's severity.

model.title: Explanation model
model.description: Model alias or ID used for the explanation.
